tools.name: docbrain_ask
tools.description: Ask a question against your organization's documentation. Returns an answer with source attribution across all connected knowledge sources (Confluence, Notion, GitHub, Slack, etc.).

tools.name: docbrain_incident
tools.description: Query documentation in the context of an ongoing incident. Returns relevant runbooks, past incident reports, and troubleshooting guides with source attribution.

tools.name: docbrain_freshness
tools.description: Check the freshness and staleness of documentation. Identifies docs that may be outdated based on recent code changes, PRs, or time elapsed since last update.

tools.name: docbrain_autopilot_gaps
tools.description: Analyze your documentation for gaps — areas that are undocumented or insufficiently documented based on your codebase and recent activity.

tools.name: docbrain_autopilot_generate
tools.description: Generate missing documentation for identified gaps. Produces draft documentation grounded in your codebase, PRs, Slack threads, and existing docs.

tools.name: docbrain_autopilot_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of Autopilot activity — recently generated docs, identified gaps, freshness alerts, and documentation health metrics.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password for the DocBrain database

LLM_PROVIDER.description: LLM provider to use (anthropic | bedrock | openai | ollama)

LLM_MODEL_ID.description: Model ID for the LLM provider (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929)

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key (required if LLM_PROVIDER=openai or EMBED_PROVIDER=openai)

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS access key ID (required if LLM_PROVIDER=bedrock and not using instance profile)

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: AWS secret access key (required if LLM_PROVIDER=bedrock and not using instance profile)

EMBED_MODEL_ID.description: Model ID for the embedding provider (e.g. text-embedding-3-small)
